title: The Event Feed That Keeps Stale Updates
description: Replayed messages replace newer event data, and event order changes when the same batch is imported twice.
objective: Trace the reported failures, repair the implementation, and verify edge cases without changing the public API.
expectedBehavior: latest_events(rows) selects the greatest version per event ID; equal versions keep the first record. Output is sorted by event ID. Reject empty IDs or negative versions, never mutate input. Python rows are dicts with id/version/value. C++ Event has string id, int version, string value.
constraints: Use the language standard library only; no network calls or external packages.
Do not modify read-only tests or caller-owned data.
